_what_this_is: Requirement AMENDMENTS to SOURCE 1 v2 (the outcome-organised external security requirements). Each amendment is a separate, provenance-carrying record: the amended requirement is NOT edited, and a sealed external copy of the requirement source is never rewritten. An amendment applies only when scripts/deny_requirements.py's authored ruling table carries the same amendment_id with identical provenance.
_classification: SECURITY_CRITICAL — tracked Tier-1 synthetic amendment record, consumed by deny_requirements.requirement_amendments() when the requirement source is the tracked synthetic set. An external requirement source takes its amendments only from SIGNALNEST_REQUIREMENT_AMENDMENTS_PATH.
_original_requirement_preserved: O11 in tests/fixtures/synthetic-requirements.json (and in the external SOURCE 1 v2 record) is unchanged: outcome 'the keys protecting state and secrets are used, delegated, or destroyed', gate 4N-H1, permanent, principal 'any principal in the SignalNest design', actions kms:CreateGrant/Decrypt/DisableKey/PutKeyPolicy/ReEncryptFrom/ReEncryptTo/RetireGrant/RevokeGrant/ScheduleKeyDeletion (action-set sha256 below).

amendments.replaces: For the expiring key-apply principal (key_apply) and the action kms:PutKeyPolicy ONLY, this amendment replaces O11's previous universal enforcement (EXPLICIT_DENY at Resource "*" for every designed principal). It changes that universal Resource "*" enforcement for this one principal/action pair and for nothing else.
retains: unconditional explicit denial of kms:PutKeyPolicy on the two protected keys (the state CMK and the secrets CMK)
the existing bypass Deny (kms:BypassPolicyLockoutSafetyCheck = true is explicitly denied)
the reviewed b-wide Allow's expiry (DateLessThan aws:CurrentTime) and Region (aws:RequestedRegion) conditions
unchanged O11 protection (EXPLICIT_DENY at Resource "*") for every other covered principal and every other O11 action, key_apply's included
amendments.context: D-K1-3 = (b-wide), operator decision 2026-10-23: the key-apply principal holds an expiring, region-conditioned Allow of kms:PutKeyPolicy on Resource "*" because the CreateKey policy-lockout check requires the caller to hold it. The amendment does not establish that AWS's lockout-safety check accepts the conditioned Allow.
